Definition: Chashum, the name of two or three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hashum heads a family of 223 exiles who return with Zerubbabel, and the name turns up again beside Ezra as the law is read and among those who seal the covenant. The same name covers a family head, a listener at the reading, and a sealer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the returning families in His record from the journey home to the reading of the law. Hashum's name follows the whole arc of the return.
RelatedEvents: Ezra Reads the Law; Israel Renews the Covenant
